About this water

The fishery source record for Manas River Lodge, Bhutan, identifies Putitor mahseer and Copper mahseer. These are documented species in the linked research, not a promised catch list. Check the source's named water and scope when you select the target; a regional reference does not establish the same fishing opportunity at every access point.

For the Manas River Lodge program, ask the provider to connect the mahseer targets with the actual guided waters. Putitor and copper mahseer are separate species in the record, not a promise of both on one visit. Confirm transfers, allocated fishing days and the tackle specification before travel.
